commands.command: pnpm --filter @fairbite/api exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts test/unit/identity/changePassword.spec.ts
commands.detail: 2 tests: both password fields and the context are forwarded; the null result the pinned client reads as invalid password is propagated.

4 tests: exact pinned document; new hash verifies and the old one does not; sign-in with the new password works; the caller's session survives while the other family is revoked; wrong old password returns null and changes nothing; short new password is BAD_USER_INPUT; anonymous caller is refused.
18 files / 104 tests green on commit d8eb417 (recorded before the parallel W25 tooling lane landed its own commits).

evidenceStatus.reason: The apps list is app and app(sv), so the evidence checker requires device evidence from the not-yet-built W19 harness. The record stays NOT_VERIFIED.

knownLimits: Contract choices recorded, not invented: a wrong old password returns null because the pinned screen branches on falsiness and shows its own invalid-password message; success returns the truthy String "ok" because the screen only tests truthiness (upstream's exact String is UNVERIFIED).
Session policy: every other family is revoked atomically with the hash change; the caller's own session stays usable, matching the screen that keeps the user signed in.
The current password is verified with the same global hash-work bound as login, and the mutation is rate-limited per caller.
